summary: Android kept Amber in the live Kit editor across HOME/resume. While that draft was open, the Windows window showed the saved Coral on the same board. Android also showed Coral after a cold reopen. BoardView owns the draft; only Save submits through EditClient to store::rename_item_at_revision. This retry updated the workflow register using the prior worker and operator results below; it did not repeat the live gates.
evidence: Operator: node scripts/cross-client-reopen.mjs passed on Rustday_Edit_X64 against a fresh rustday_test fixture. Blank Save showed Name required. Fresh reads after rejection and after typing Coral and dismissing the IME still found Review sketch (revision 1) and Ink (1). Save committed Coral to the second row and advanced only its revision to 2.

Operator: the second Kit Input showed Amber with the IME dismissed before HOME. After the activity stopped and its task returned, Review sketch remained above the Amber editor in the same process (PID 6548) and local activity (c38647). A fresh store connection still found Review sketch (1) and Coral (2).

Operator: while Amber was open, --smoke-delivery inspected two visible, clean Windows Kit inputs on fixture board 09bb5bcd-079f-4eb4-a367-fda22dfb6389 in its generated schema. The upper input was bound to 00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000002a and showed Review sketch; the lower was bound to 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011 and showed Coral.

Operator: after force-stop and confirmed fixture process exit, reopening the same board and port in PID 7034 showed Review sketch above Coral in display mode, with no Amber or editor. A fresh read confirmed both original IDs in order at revisions 1 and 2. Cleanup left no fixture APK, reverse mapping or generated schema.

Operator regressions: node scripts/android-kit-frame.mjs passed without connection arguments. Both android_emulator_edit cases passed with the rebuilt probe; node --test scripts/run.test.mjs passed all 11 cases.

Prior worker: the original windows_smoke suite passed with native-smoke enabled, including rejected draft/focus, correction, pending, saved and reopen. The kit_edit_fixture example emitted its board UUID, loopback port and generated schema and exited successfully on EOF. cargo test --locked --workspace passed all eight portable integration cases; workspace and Android formatting checks and workspace Clippy with native-smoke and warnings denied passed.
